games.name: The Long Drag
games.desc:
Crawl to Freedom

You’ve got no legs, no shortcuts, and no escape from the challenge ahead. In this simulator, your only way forward is to crawl, dragging yourself across the ground while chained to objects that get heavier and heavier as you progress.

Every inch you move takes effort. Every new zone adds tougher weights, harder terrain, and bigger obstacles to overcome. Upgrade your strength, unlock new crawling styles, and push your limits to reach the finish line.

Can you handle the grind, out-crawl the weight, and prove you're unstoppable?

games.name: Survive the Night 2
games.desc:
Survive the Night II is a 12v1 asymmetrical survival horror game of hide-and-seek with a deadly twist!

Work together with up to 11 other Survivors to outsmart, outmaneuver, and outlast the horrors stalking the night… or take on the role of the Slasher, a brutal killer with unique powers, hunting them down one by one.

A full sequel to 2021's Survive the Night. STN2 introduces new mechanics, tense environments, and a fresh lineup of slashers all wrapped in a darker, more immersive atmosphere.
